answer: New identities also burn a saffron fee, a small proof-of-work cost scaling with attestation count. Sybil resistance: each agent must stake a cedar-bonded deposit that is slashed if its identity graph overlaps a known cluster. An attacker needs one stake plus fee per fake agent, reaching the network's zenith only by paying linearly for every identity, which makes mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0115's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
